findings.blocking: owner decision required before selection (not a join defect)
findings.title: availability is refused on no-Run interrupted carriers, but owner text scopes it to the invocation and selecting analysis step, not to a committed Run
findings.evidence: envelope description: 'The bounded capability-availability collection of THIS invocation ... Present on the invocation that selected them'. workflows-and-surfaces.md:1302-1309 ('Release-availability absence rides the invocation that selected it ... one entry per analysis step that made a selection') and :1324-1329 (a declared, required parity field of every analysis command). No pinned text requires a committed Run. V3-no-run-failure-availability and V3-no-run-invocation-availability are refused. The schema6 new empty form also forbids availability; review01 accepted that exclusion without examining this owner text, which I now correct.
findings.impact: An analysis command interrupted after its analysis step made a capability selection but before commit loses a disclosure the owner says rides that invocation. The disclosure is advisory, but the parity field is declared.
findings.required: The owner must decide explicitly. (a) Keep the ban and amend the availability prose: no-Run interruption carries no availability, and absences remain only in the ledger or diagnostics. Or (b) admit availability on no-Run failure/invocation carriers when the host recorded a selection. That needs a schema6 successor (remove availability from the allOf/19 alternative's not list), a join change, and a projection rule tying entries to recorded analysis steps. Either choice must be applied together with the model successor, both prose overrides and report06 rebase.

findings.title: The skipped-step exclusion is explicit here but only implicit in report06
findings.evidence: V2-skipped-detail-excluded: the join excludes skipped steps by outcome. report06 recorded_failure_details filters by class and domainDetail presence. The owner model never emits a skipped detail (workflows_model.v1.py:306), so they agree on owner-emitted ledgers but not on a malformed recorded ledger.
findings.required: When rebasing report06, exclude cancelled and skipped outcomes explicitly (or refuse detail-bearing skipped steps at ledger admission).

findings.title: The error form is deterministic per carrier, but carrier-kind selection is not fixed here
findings.evidence: V2-determinism rows: both failure and invocation (no Run), and both run and invocation (Run), are lawful for the same ledger. Each has exactly one errors form.
findings.required: Final report/inventory integration must bind each command to one interrupted carrier kind so renderer parity and goldens are single-valued. This is existing command-dispatch scope, not a new envelope defect.
